title: FIPS operational: non-FIPS algo lookup failure gives no explanation
description: In src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c:177-200, when fips_mode is active and a lookup skips a non-FIPS provider, no log is emitted. If a caller requests ctr(aes) after wolfssl is loaded (ctr(aes) only in kcapi), ioctl_init returns -ENOENT. Nothing in dmesg explains why. A support engineer will search for the algorithm in /proc/crypto, find it, and conclude the driver is broken — not that FIPS enforcement is active. Fix: emit a single pr_info at lookup time when an algo is rejected due to FIPS enforcement, naming the algo.
